texto: Extreme close-up of the photo of Ximena standing in the center of the ofrenda between flickering candles and marigolds; a trembling hand with dirty fingernails and a scraped knuckle enters the frame and slowly lifts the photo; the camera tilts up to Ximena's shocked face lit by the candles, a tear running down her cheek.
Medium shot from behind the candles of the ofrenda: Doña Refugio kneels praying with her rosary, eyes half closed; behind her, Mauricio and Daniela stand holding hands; Daniela hides a smirk.

Ximena hides behind the half-open wooden door of the inner courtyard at night, her face half in shadow and half lit by orange candlelight from the living room; she presses her hand over her mouth to hold back a sob.

At the dining table next to the ofrenda, Doña Refugio pulls the envelope out of her black dress and waves the check in front of Mauricio with greedy eyes; Daniela lifts her hand to show off the ring, smiling.
Close-up through the doorway: Ximena's eyes fill with tears as she stares; reverse close-up of the ring sparkling on Daniela's finger in the candlelight; back to Ximena clenching her jaw.

Flashback with cold desaturated blue tones: at night Ximena drives a small car on a winding mountain road above a deep ravine near Tapalpa, a phone on speaker on the dashboard; she presses the brake pedal again and again but the car does not slow down, headlights sweeping a sharp curve.
Sofi walks up to the ofrenda holding the drawing and a round pan de muerto, places them carefully under the photo frame, and looks up at the empty frame spot with big hopeful eyes.
Doña Refugio snatches the drawing from the ofrenda and crumples it in her fist in front of Sofi; Sofi bursts into tears and shouts back; Doña Refugio raises her open hand threateningly over the girl.

A hand with a scraped knuckle grabs Doña Refugio's raised wrist mid-air; a gust of wind blows out all the candles of the ofrenda at once, petals fly; everyone turns: Ximena stands there in the doorway, bandaged; Doña Refugio turns pale and crosses herself, Daniela drops her wine glass, Mauricio freezes.

Slow push-in on Ximena's face lit only by the smoking candle wicks and moonlight, cold and calm, staring at Doña Refugio; then a quick cut to Mauricio, pale and sweating, looking down at his phone screen as it lights up his face.
